question: An engineer must configure a Cisco MDS 9000 Series Switch for traffic analysis from the storage array. The storage array is connected to the interface fc2/1 in VSAN 10 and the traffic analyzer to fc4/2. The capture file must include ingress and egress traffic between the switch and the storage array. Also, only traffic in VSAN 10 must be captured. Which configuration set meets these requirements?
options:
interface fc4/2
switchport mode trunk
switchport trunk allow vsan 10
no shutdown
!
span session 1
source interface fc2/1 tx
destination interface fc4/2 rx
no suspend

interface fc4/2
switchport mode SD
no shutdown
!
span session 1
source interface fc2/1
destination interface fc4/2
source filter vsan 10

interface fc4/2
switchport mode auto
no shutdown
!
span session 1
source interface fc2/1 rx
destination interface fc4/2
source filter vsan 10
no suspend

interface fc4/2
switchport mode ST
no shutdown
!
span session 1
source interface fc2/1
destination interface fc4/2
source filter vsan 10
theory: Capturing both ingress and egress traffic between the switch and the storage array requires a SPAN source specified without an rx/tx qualifier (which spans both directions by default) on fc2/1, paired with a destination interface in SD mode (fc4/2), and because only VSAN 10 traffic should be captured, a 'source filter vsan 10' is applied to the session so traffic from other VSANs sharing the physical port is excluded from the mirrored copy. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 11 - SPAN)
